comment.body: Thanks for reporting the 0.99.1 GitHub installer issue. The current bundle has a standard WiX bootstrapper and failure screen, but “doesn’t load” does not tell whether Windows blocks the download, no process starts, or setup opens and fails. Could you describe exactly what appears after double-clicking it and whether an installer process shows in Task Manager? A screenshot of any prompt would identify the next owner; no generic diagnostic upload is needed.
